sentences.en: TIM: Good morning.
sentences.zh: TIM: 早上好。

sentences.en: You're through to the tourist information office, Tim speaking.
sentences.zh: 您已接入旅游信息办公室，我是蒂姆。

sentences.en: How can I help you?
sentences.zh: 有什么可以帮您的吗？

sentences.en: JEAN: Oh hello.
sentences.zh: JEAN: 哦，您好。

sentences.en: Could you give me some information about next month's festival, please?
sentences.zh: 请问您能给我提供一些关于下个月节日活动的信息吗？

sentences.en: My family and I will be staying in the town that week.
sentences.zh: 我和我的家人将在那周住在镇上。

sentences.en: TIM: Of course.
sentences.zh: TIM: 当然可以。

sentences.en: Well it starts with a concert on a the afternoon of the 17th.
sentences.zh: 嗯，活动将从17日下午的一场音乐会开始。

sentences.en: JEAN: Oh I heard about that.
sentences.zh: JEAN: 哦，我听说过那场音乐会。

sentences.en: The orchestra and singers come from the USA, don't they?
sentences.zh: 乐团和歌手来自美国，对吗？

sentences.en: TIM: They're from Canada.
sentences.zh: TIM: 他们来自加拿大。

sentences.en: They're very popular over there.
sentences.zh: 他们在当地非常受欢迎。

sentences.en: They're going to perform a number of well-known pieces that will appeal to children as well as adults.
sentences.zh: 他们将演奏多首广为人知的曲目，既适合儿童也适合成人。

sentences.en: JEAN: That sounds good.
sentences.zh: JEAN: 听起来不错。

sentences.en: My whole family are interested in music.
sentences.zh: 我们全家人都对音乐感兴趣。

sentences.en: TIM: The next day, the 18th, there's a performance by a ballet company called Eustatis.
sentences.zh: TIM: 第二天，也就是18日，将有一场名为“欧斯塔提斯”的芭蕾舞团演出。

sentences.en: JEAN: Sorry?
sentences.zh: JEAN: 抱歉，您能再说一遍吗？

sentences.en: TIM: The name iS spelt E-U-S-T-A-T-I-S.
sentences.zh: TIM: 这个名字拼写为E-U-S-T-A-T-I-S。

sentences.en: They appeared in last year's festival, and went down very well.
sentences.zh: 他们去年曾参加过本镇的节日活动，反响非常好。

sentences.en: Again, their programme is designed for all ages.
sentences.zh: 同样，他们的节目也是为所有年龄段观众设计的。

sentences.en: JEAN: Good.
sentences.zh: JEAN: 好。

sentences.en: I expect we'll go to that.
sentences.zh: 我想我们会去看那场演出。

sentences.en: I hope there's going to be a play during the festival, a comedy, ideally.
sentences.zh: 我希望节日期间会有一出戏剧，最好是喜剧。

sentences.en: TIM: You're in luck!
sentences.zh: TIM: 您真幸运！

sentences.en: On the 19th and 20th a local amateur group are performing one written by a member of the group.
sentences.zh: 19日和20日，一支本地业余剧团将上演一部由该团成员创作的剧目。

sentences.en: It's called Jemima.
sentences.zh: 剧名叫《杰米玛》。

sentences.en: That'll be on in the town hall.
sentences.zh: 演出地点是镇政厅。

sentences.en: They've already performed it two or three times. haven't seen it myself, but the review in the local paper was very good.
sentences.zh: 该剧已公演过两三次了；我自己还没看过，但当地报纸上的评论非常好。

sentences.en: JEAN: And is it suitable for children?
sentences.zh: JEAN: 那它适合儿童观看吗？

sentences.en: TIM: Yes, in fact it's aimed more at children than at adults, so both performances are in the afternoon.
sentences.zh: TIM: 是的，事实上该剧主要面向儿童而非成人，因此两场演出都安排在下午。

sentences.en: JEAN: And what about dance?
sentences.zh: JEAN: 那舞蹈表演呢？

sentences.en: Will there be any performances?
sentences.zh: 节日期间会有舞蹈演出吗？

sentences.en: TIM: Yes, also on the 20th, but in the evening.
sentences.zh: TIM: 有，同样在20日，但安排在晚上。

sentences.en: A professional company is putting on a show of modern pieces, with electronic music by young composers.
sentences.zh: 一家专业舞团将献上一场现代舞蹈作品展演，配乐为年轻作曲家创作的电子音乐。

sentences.en: JEAN: Uh-huh.
sentences.zh: JEAN: 嗯。

sentences.en: TIM: The show is about how people communicate, or fail to communicate, with each other, so it's got the rather strange name, Chat.
sentences.zh: TIM: 这场演出的主题是人们如何相互沟通，或为何无法沟通，因此取了一个颇为奇特的名字——《聊天》。

sentences.en: JEAN: I suppose that's because that's something we do both face to face and online.
sentences.zh: JEAN: 我想这大概是因为‘聊天’正是我们面对面以及在线上都会做的事情。

sentences.en: TIM: That's right.
sentences.zh: TIM: 没错。

sentences.en: TIM: Now there are also some workshops and other activities.
sentences.zh: TIM: 此外，还有一些工作坊及其他活动。

sentences.en: They'll all take place at least once every day, so everyone who wants to take part will have a chance.
sentences.zh: 所有活动每天至少举办一次，因此每位希望参与的人都有机会参加。

sentences.en: JEAN: Good.
sentences.zh: JEAN: 好。

sentences.en: We're particularly interested in cookery - you don't happen to have a cookery workshop, do you?
sentences.zh: 我们尤其对烹饪感兴趣——你们碰巧有烹饪工作坊吗？

sentences.en: TIM: We certainly do.
sentences.zh: TIM: 我们当然有。

sentences.en: It's going to focus on tO how to make food part of a healthy lifestyle, and it'll show that even sweet things like cakes can contain much less sugar than they usually do.
sentences.zh: 该工作坊将聚焦于如何让食物成为健康生活方式的一部分，并会展示就连蛋糕这类甜食，其含糖量也可以远低于通常水平。

sentences.en: JEAN: That might be worth going to.
sentences.zh: JEAN: 这个或许值得一去。

sentences.en: We're trying to encourage our children to cook.
sentences.zh: 我们正努力鼓励孩子们动手做饭。

sentences.en: TIM: Another workshop is just for children, and that's on creating posters to reflect the history of the town.
sentences.zh: TIM: 另一个工作坊专为儿童开设，主题是制作海报以展现本镇的历史。

sentences.en: The aim is to make children aware of how both the town and people's lives have changed over the centuries.
sentences.zh: 其目的是让孩子们了解本镇及人们的生活在数个世纪以来发生了怎样的变化。

sentences.en: The results will be exhibited in the community centre.
sentences.zh: 成果将在社区中心展出。

sentences.en: Then the other workshop is in toy-making, and that's for adults only.
sentences.zh: 此外还有一个玩具制作工作坊，仅限成人参加。

sentences.en: Audioscripts
sentences.zh: 听力原文

sentences.en: JEAN: Oh, why's that?
sentences.zh: JEAN: 哦，这是为什么呢？

sentences.en: TIM: Because it involves carpentry - participants will be making toys out of wood, so there'll be a lot of sharp chisels and other tools around.
sentences.zh: TIM: 因为它涉及木工——参与者将用木材制作玩具，现场会有很多锋利的凿子及其他工具。

sentences.en: JEAN: It makes sense to keep children away from it.
sentences.zh: JEAN: 确实有必要让孩子们远离这项活动。

sentences.en: TIM: Exactly.
sentences.zh: TIM: 没错。

sentences.en: Now let me tell you about some of the outdoor activities.
sentences.zh: 现在让我来介绍一下一些户外活动。

sentences.en: There'll be supervised wild swimming .
sentences.zh: 将组织有专人监管的野外游泳活动。

sentences.en: JEAN: Wild swimming?
sentences.zh: JEAN: 野外游泳？

sentences.en: What's that?
sentences.zh: 那是什么？

sentences.en: TIM: It just means swimming in natural waters, rather than swimming pool.
sentences.zh: TIM: 这仅指在天然水域中游泳，而非在游泳池里。

sentences.en: JEAN: Oh OK.
sentences.zh: JEAN: 哦，明白了。

sentences.en: In a lake, for instance.
sentences.zh: 比如在湖里。

sentences.en: TIM: Yes, there's a beautiful one just outside the town, and that'll be the venue for the swimming.
sentences.zh: TIM: 没错，镇外就有一处风景优美的湖泊，游泳活动就将在那里举行。

sentences.en: There'll be lifeguards on duty, so it's suitable for all ages.
sentences.zh: 现场将配备救生员，因此适合所有年龄段的人参与。

sentences.en: And finally, there'll be a walk in some nearby woods every day.
sentences.zh: 最后，每天还会组织一次附近林地的徒步活动。

sentences.en: The leader is an expert on insects.
sentences.zh: 领队是一位昆虫学专家。

sentences.en: He'll show some that live in the woods, and how important they are for the environment.
sentences.zh: 他将向大家介绍栖息于林地中的部分昆虫，以及它们对环境的重要性。

sentences.en: So there are going to be all sorts of different things to do during the festival.
sentences.zh: 因此，节日期间将有各种各样的活动可供选择。

sentences.en: JEAN: There certainly are.
sentences.zh: JEAN: 的确如此。

sentences.en: TIM: If you'd like to read about how the preparations for the festival are going, the festival organiser is keeping a blog.
sentences.zh: TIM: 如果您想了解节日筹备工作的进展情况，活动组织者正在维护一个博客。

sentences.en: Just search online for the festival website, and you'll find it.
sentences.zh: 只需在网上搜索节日官网，就能找到它。

sentences.en: JEAN: Well, thank you very much for all the information.
sentences.zh: JEAN: 非常感谢您提供这么多信息。

sentences.en: TIM: You're welcome.
sentences.zh: TIM: 不客气。

sentences.en: Goodbye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: JEAN: Goodbye.
sentences.zh: JEAN: 再见。
